posts.title: About
posts.description: I hope to write some things. My purposes are yet unclear to me, but I recognize that other people have said some things that seem related: If you’re thinking without writing, you only think you’re thinking. – Leslie Lamport Art is the solution of a problem which cannot be expressed explicitly until it is solved. – Piet Hein Creative work is always a conversation. Or it doesn’t happen. – Andrew Plo
